scope: Publication of approved Korean Rust streaming log CLI guide and examples

independentReview.mode: Separate AI context, article read before code and official source snapshots; read-only review and correction recheck

findingsResolved.finding: Diagnostic eprintln could panic on broken stderr instead of exiting with code 2
findingsResolved.change: Ignore failure of writeln on locked stderr and preserve code 2
findingsResolved.recheck: Reviewer reproduced exit 2 with closed stderr pipe in a fresh release build

findingsResolved.finding: Exit 1 wording could imply at least one valid record
findingsResolved.change: Clarified completed analysis with invalid records and valid=0 possibility
findingsResolved.recheck: Reviewer confirmed all-invalid input returns valid=0, invalid=1 and code 1

findingsResolved.finding: Current-line memory wording did not distinguish BufReader read-ahead
findingsResolved.change: Separated analysis Vec contents from BufReader prefetched bytes

independentReview.initialExecution: Rust 1.100.0 tests 8, fmt, clippy and release build; selected CLI normal/error cases and BufReader read-ahead probe
independentReview.recheckExecution: Fresh release build, broken stderr and all-invalid CLI cases

image.alt: main이 파일 인자를 확인하고 BufReader로 분석을 시작한다. 현재 줄을 최대 4097바이트 읽고 EOF면 집계를 반환한다. 읽기 실패·4096바이트 초과·잘못된 UTF-8은 오류 반환이다. 형식이 맞으면 상태별 개수를 늘리고 틀리면 invalid를 늘린 뒤 다음 줄을 읽는다. main은 정렬된 집계를 출력하고 결과에 따라 종료 코드 0·1·2를 전달한다

preview.renderer: Site Satteri Markdown renderer and site CSS with resolved image placeholder

limits: Simplified two-field log format; not an Nginx/Apache default log parser
Completed ordinary files assumed; no tailing, rotation or compressed input
No throughput or process memory benchmark
